panel.title: Over-budget approval
panel.short: Budget line {line} does not have enough for this request
panel.hint: Ask only for what is short. Once approved, that amount is set aside for this request and you send the request as usual.
panel.pendingHint: Waiting for the approver. Until then the request's amount and budget line cannot change and the request cannot be sent.
panel.approvedHint: This amount is set aside for the request until {date}. Send the request before then.

ask.title: Ask for over-budget approval
ask.description: Ask for the {shortfall} baht that is short. The approver of the over-budget rule in the DOA reads your reason.
ask.descriptionPlain: Ask for the amount that is short. The approver of the over-budget rule in the DOA reads your reason.
ask.reason: Why the request needs more than the budget
ask.reasonHint: The approver reads this · at least 3 characters
ask.sent: Sent {number} for over-budget approval. Waiting for the approver.

cancel.title: Cancel over-budget approval {number}
cancel.textPending: Its open approval task closes. This cannot be undone; to go over budget again you ask again.
cancel.textApproved: The approved amount leaves the budget line at once. This cannot be undone; to go over budget again you ask again.

detail.heading: Over-budget approval {number}
detail.requestNet: The request needed when asked (before VAT)
detail.returned: Returned to the line at use or lapse
detail.returnedAfterUse: Returned to the line after use
detail.openTask: Open the approval task of this item
detail.notFound: This over-budget approval was not found
detail.forbidden: You may not open this item

hint.PENDING_APPROVAL: Waiting for the approver of the over-budget rule. Meanwhile the request's amount and budget line are locked.
hint.APPROVED: Approved. The amount is in the budget line and set aside for the source request, used when the requester sends it.
hint.CONSUMED: The source request was sent and used this amount. What it did not use went back to the line.
hint.RETURNED: The approver returned it. The budget did not change; the requester may ask again from the request page.
hint.REJECTED: Rejected. The budget did not change.
hint.CANCELLED: Cancelled. Anything set aside has left the budget line.
hint.LAPSED: It lapsed before the request was sent. The amount has left the budget line.

task.title: Over-budget approval to decide
task.effect: Approved, this amount enters the budget line and is set aside for the source request until the requester sends it or it lapses · Returned or rejected, the budget does not change

errors.DOA_NOT_CONFIGURED: The DOA in effect has no over-budget rule, so this cannot be sent. Tell the DOA administrator.
errors.NOT_OVER_BUDGET: The budget line has enough for this request now. No over-budget approval is needed; send the request.
errors.LINE_NOT_OPEN: The request's budget line is frozen or closed. Choose another line in the request first.
errors.OVERRUN_EXISTS: This request already has an over-budget approval waiting or approved. Reload the page to see where it stands.
errors.NO_LINES: This request has no items yet. Add the items before asking.
errors.REASON: Give a reason of at least 3 characters
errors.REASON_TOO_LONG: The reason is longer than {max} characters. Shorten it.
errors.INPUT: Something is missing or not valid. Check and try again.
errors.STATE: The request or this item changed state. Reload the page to see where it stands.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This item is no longer there. Reload the page.
errors.NO_APPROVER: No one holds the position that approves this under the DOA. Tell the organization administrator.
errors.TAX_RATE: There is no VAT rate for today, so the shortfall cannot be worked out. Tell the system administrator.
errors.FORBIDDEN: Only the requester of this request may ask for or cancel an over-budget approval.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Sign in again and try again.
errors.BUSY: The system is busy with another task. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.CONFLICT: This was already sent with other details. Check and send again.
errors.INTERNAL: Not saved because of a system error. Tell the system administrator with reference {requestId}.
